command: Original6b480..6b64f consumes ECX record type and EDX context pointer, saves/assigns all other registers, no incoming stack/x87/flags or hidden outputs, RET0. Actual first type80 has NULL context on both sides, no pointee bytes exist/read. Only recordtypeC3 dereferences context+4; that unvisited branch is independently controlled, not NULL-compatible. Return is the OmfRecord pointer in EAX.
